title: Pure Evol
summary: Evoltile, Evolsaur and Evolzar cards with generic staples. The Evoltiles Tribute or flip themselves to summon Evolsaurs from the Deck, and the Evolsaurs gain an effect when an Evoltile summons them; two Level 4 or Level 6 Dinosaurs become the Evolzar Xyz Monsters. The 2023 cards lead: Evolsaur Lios, the one-card starter, Sets Evolutionary Bridge or Evo-Singularity and matches two monsters' Levels, Evoltile Pholis Sets Evo-Force or Evo-Instant, and Evolzar Lars negates on either turn.
